data.name: Justinian
data.gender_notes: Justinian is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Justinian is recorded in name-lists as “Righteous, just, rule”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Justinian expresses “Righteous, just, rule”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Justinian total 36, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

in_hebrew.name: יוסטיניאן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יוסי (Josiah) - God is bountiful, טוב (tov) - good, יני (yin) - bountiful, אן (an) - God

in_greek.name: Ιουστινιανός
in_greek.long_meaning: Ιούστος (Ioustos) - God is bountiful, Νική (Nike) - victory

in_latin.name: Iustinianus
in_latin.long_meaning: Ius (ius) - law, statute, right, Justus (Justus) - just, righteous
